meta.source: Blizzard Game Data journal-encounter + Wowhead tooltip API
meta.readMe: Ability text and damage magnitudes come from Wowhead's tooltip endpoint, which is the only source carrying tuned numbers for this tier -- Blizzard's /data/wow/spell/<id> returns 404 for these ids and the in-game journal text ships 'X' placeholders. A magnitude here is ONE difficulty's value and the endpoint does not say which; cross-check against measured damage taken in profiles/<spec>-<difficulty>.json before quoting it as a Mythic number.

encounter.name: The Twin Fangs
encounter.description: The first of Ula'tek's blood, Vexhul and Ithraz brood beneath a roiling sea of venom deep within the vault of Atal'Utek. Any foolish enough to enter the prison's inner chamber risk their monstrous jaws and toxic strikes.

notes.title: Overview
notes.bodyText:
The Twin Fangs' [Eternal Venom] accumulates throughout the battle. Vexhul funnels toxin into her target with [Caustic Deluge] forming [Caustic Globules] and calls her progeny with [Venomous Emergence]. Ithraz consumes players with [Ravenous Feast] and strikes repeatedly with [Stone Breaker].

At 100 energy, both serpents submerge and reposition before attacking together. Vexhul releases a [Vile Flood] while Ithraz spews globs of gore during [Sanguine Storm].

notes.title: Damage Dealers
notes.bodyText:
$bullet;[Caustic Deluge] ejects a salvo of globules which afflict players with [Eternal Venom] when touched.


$bullet;[Venomous Emergence] summons Spawns of Vexhul which will continuously target players with [Corrosive Spit].

abilities.title: Eternal Venom
abilities.description:
Being struck by some abilities causes an everlasting venom to course through the target's veins, inflicting 10001 Nature damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

Upon reaching 11 applications, the target dies.

abilities.title: Caustic Deluge
abilities.description:
Vexhul funnels toxin into her current target for 5 sec, inflicting 250022 Nature damage every 0.5 sec and ejecting acid nearby.

Each acid splash inflicts 916747 Nature damage and applies Eternal Venom to players within 4 yards, forming a Caustic Globule at the impact location.

abilities.title: Caustic Globule
abilities.description:
An acidic globule forms and ruptures after 10 sec, inflicting 625055 Nature damage and applying Eternal Venom to all players.

Upon contact, the globule instead only affects that player.

abilities.title: Envenomed
abilities.description: Caustic Deluge damage increases damage taken from Caustic Deluge by 10% for 1.5 min. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Venomous Emergence
abilities.description: Vexhul calls her progeny from the churning sea, inflicting 125011 Nature damage and applying Eternal Venom to all players.

abilities.title: Corrosive Spit
abilities.description: The spawn focuses on a player and spews toxin in a frontal line, inflicting 666725 Nature damage and applying Eternal Venom to players struck.

abilities.title: Stir the Depths
abilities.description:
Vexhul thrashes and churns the surrounding sea of venom for 6 sec, inflicting 166681 Nature damage to all players every 2 sec and forming waves.

The waves travel across the platform, inflicting 125011 Nature damage every 1 sec and applying Eternal Venom to players struck.

abilities.title: Vile Flood
abilities.description: Vexhul channels a continuous torrent of toxin in a frontal direction for 14 sec, inflicting 416703 Nature damage every 0.5 sec and applying Eternal Venom to players struck.

abilities.title: Concentrated Spittle
abilities.description: Vexhul pelts her current target with spittle if they are out of range, inflicting Nature damage.

abilities.title: Blood Torrent
abilities.description:
Ithraz channels a torrent of blood into his target for 5 sec. Every 1 sec, the torrent applies a 426295 healing absorb to the target. This effect stacks.

Expunged blood coalesces around each Caustic Globule, forming a Barbed Bulwark.

abilities.title: Barbed Bulwark
abilities.description:
Blood Torrent protects each Caustic Globule, inflicting 500044 Shadow damage and knocking back players while it persists.

Interrupting Barbed Bulwark destroys it.

abilities.title: Rouse the Brood
abilities.description: Ithraz thrashes, calling several Broodlings of Ithraz to the surface and releasing a nova of blood that inflicts 208352 Shadow damage to all players.

abilities.title: Visceral Burst
abilities.description:
The broodling convulses, releasing a violent burst that inflicts 625055 Shadow damage to all players and an additional 208352 Shadow damage every 1 sec for 6 sec. This effect stacks.

If interrupted, the broodling retreats to the depths below.

abilities.title: Ravenous Feast
abilities.description:
Ithraz attempts to consume players 3 times in quick succession. Each strike inflicts 4625407 Physical damage split evenly among players within 14 yards.

Ithraz consumes 1 application of Eternal Venom from players struck, applying Feasted to them and knocking them away.

If Ravenous Feast fails to hit at least 4 targets all players suffer the full effect.

abilities.title: Feasted
abilities.description: Increases damage taken from Ravenous Feast by 0% for 8 sec and prevents Ithraz from consuming further applications of Eternal Venom from this player.

abilities.title: Tainted Blood
abilities.description: Ravenous Feast expels several founts of frothing blood for up to 8 sec. Every (1 / 2) sec, each fount absorbs the next 71049 healing received by players within 5 yards.

abilities.title: Tainted Burst
abilities.description: If a fount of Tainted Blood is not fully absorbed before it expires, it detonates and inflicts 1250110 Shadow damage to all players.

abilities.title: Coiling Ichor
abilities.description:
Ithraz infuses several players with vile ichor, inflicting 75007 Shadow damage to players within 0 yards every 1 sec for 12 sec. Over time, the ichor inflicts increasing damage as it shrinks in area.

Upon expiration, the ichor forms a pool of Congealed Gore.

abilities.title: Congealed Gore
abilities.description: A pool of thick gore persists for 2 min, inflicting 83341 Shadow damage every 1 sec and reducing the movement speed of players within by 50%.

abilities.title: Stone Breaker
abilities.description:
Ithraz roars, pushing players away. He then slams the platform repeatedly. Each impact inflicts 2500220 Physical damage to players within 3.5 yards and increases their damage taken from Stone Breaker by 33% for 1.5 min. This effect stacks.

If no players are struck, Ithraz instead inflicts 916747 Physical damage to all players and knocks them away. This effect ignores armor.

abilities.title: Sanguine Storm
abilities.description: Ithraz showers the platform with globs of gore for 18 sec. Each impact inflicts 500044 Shadow damage to players within 4 yards.

abilities.title: Congealed Gore
abilities.description: A pool of thick gore persists for 6 sec, inflicting 83341 Shadow damage every 1 sec and reducing the movement speed of players within by 50%.

abilities.title: Clotted Bolt
abilities.description: Ithraz lances his current target with gore if they are out of range, inflicting Shadow damage.

abilities.title: Submerge
abilities.description: The Twin Fangs submerge, showering the nearby area with venom that inflicts 500044 Nature damage to players within 6 yards of each impact and forming a Noxious Slick.

abilities.title: Noxious Slick
abilities.description: A slick of noxious fluid coats the platform, inflicting 83341 Nature damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage taken of players within by 30%.

abilities.title: Toxic Fumes
abilities.description: The Twin Fangs suffuse the air with toxic fumes, inflicting 104176 Nature damage to all players every 2 sec.

abilities.title: Uncoiled Wrath
abilities.description: When Vexhul or Ithraz dies, the surviving serpent enters a vengeful rage and gains 30% increased damage every 3 sec. This effect stacks.
